sunzi.oneLineZh: 以《孙子兵法》讲求庙算与诡道，成为兵学传统中的核心论兵人物。
sunzi.oneLineEn: Centers the Art of War tradition on strategic calculation and the way of deception.

zigong.oneLineZh: 孔门弟子，以言语辞令和政事外交能力见称，承接儒家交聘传统。
zigong.oneLineEn: Confucius's disciple noted for speech, statecraft, and diplomacy in the Confucian embassy tradition.

shang-yang.oneLineZh: 战国法家改革者，以变法和严刑重势推动秦国制度转型。
shang-yang.oneLineEn: Warring States Legalist reformer who drove Qin's institutional turn via law, harsh penalties, and power-position.

shen-dao.oneLineZh: 战国稷下学者，以势治与客观权位条件解释政治秩序之可能。
shen-dao.oneLineEn: Jixia thinker who explains political order through positional power and objective conditions of authority.

gongsun-long.oneLineZh: 战国名家，以白马非马等论式逼问名实关系与指谓界限。
gongsun-long.oneLineEn: School of Names figure probing name-reality limits via white-horse-is-not-horse style arguments.

xu-xing.oneLineZh: 战国农家，主张君民并耕，其说主要见于《孟子》论辩。
xu-xing.oneLineEn: Agriculturalist urging rulers to till alongside the people; known mainly through debates in Mencius.

zou-yan.oneLineZh: 战国阴阳家，以五德终始与大九州说组织历史和空间想象。
zou-yan.oneLineEn: Yin-Yang school thinker organizing history and space via five-virtue cycles and the Great Nine Continents.

lu-buwei.oneLineZh: 战国末秦相，组织编纂《吕氏春秋》，汇合诸子以备统一秩序。
lu-buwei.oneLineEn: Late Qin chancellor who sponsored Lüshi chunqiu, synthesizing masters for a unified order.

li-si.oneLineZh: 秦帝国制度建设核心官僚，把荀学训练接入法家治理实践。
li-si.oneLineEn: Key Qin empire institution-builder linking Xunzi-style training to Legalist governance practice.

jia-yi.oneLineZh: 西汉初政论家，以秦亡反思与制度更化主张影响文治方向。
jia-yi.oneLineEn: Early Han political essayist shaping civil order via Qin-collapse lessons and institutional reform proposals.

wang-fu.oneLineZh: 东汉政论家，借《潜夫论》批评时政、吏治与士风虚矫。
wang-fu.oneLineEn: Eastern Han critic using Qianfu lun against administration, officialdom, and hollow scholarly fashions.

ji-kang.oneLineZh: 魏晋玄学名士，以自然、音乐与养生论对抗礼法之苛细。
ji-kang.oneLineEn: Wei-Jin xuanxue figure opposing rigid ritual law through naturalness, music theory, and nourishing life.

pei-wei.oneLineZh: 西晋思想家，作《崇有论》以反拨贵无玄学的空无倾向。
pei-wei.oneLineEn: Western Jin thinker whose Chongyou lun counters empty-nothing trends in Guiwu metaphysics.

zhan-ruoshui.oneLineZh: 明代甘泉学派代表，与王阳明并立，主随处体认天理之学。
zhan-ruoshui.oneLineEn: Ming Ganquan master who, with Wang Yangming, taught recognizing Heavenly principle wherever one is.

gao-panlong.oneLineZh: 晚明东林领袖，兼重静坐工夫与政治名节及清议之实践。
gao-panlong.oneLineEn: Late Ming Donglin leader joining quiet-sitting practice to political integrity and pure-discussion.

fang-yizhi.oneLineZh: 明清之际思想家，会通儒释道并深入考察自然名物之知。
fang-yizhi.oneLineEn: Ming-Qing thinker bridging Confucianism, Buddhism, Daoism and investigating natural names and things.

cheng-xuanying.oneLineZh: 唐代道教学者，以老庄义疏系统展开重玄双遣的解经路线。
cheng-xuanying.oneLineEn: Tang Daoist scholiast reading Laozi and Zhuangzi through double-mystery (Chongxuan) exegesis.

wu-cheng.oneLineZh: 元代理学家，调和朱陆并重整经学注释以及教学秩序安排。
wu-cheng.oneLineEn: Yuan Neo-Confucian reconciling Zhu-Lu lines and reorganizing classical commentary and teaching order.

dong-zhongshu.oneLineZh: 西汉儒家，以春秋学、阴阳五行对接王朝更化与天人之际。
dong-zhongshu.oneLineEn: Western Han Confucian linking Spring-Autumn learning and yin-yang five phases to dynastic reform.

wang-chong.oneLineZh: 东汉思想家，以《论衡》疾虚妄，批判谶纬与神化传说。
wang-chong.oneLineEn: Eastern Han critic who, in Lunheng, attacks prophetic weft texts and deified lore as empty claims.

liu-an.oneLineZh: 西汉淮南王，主持《淮南子》编纂，熔铸道论与治国方略。
liu-an.oneLineEn: Prince of Huainan who directed the Huainanzi, fusing Daoist discourse with arts of governance.

lu-jia.oneLineZh: 汉初政论家，以《新语》论秦亡汉兴，强调文治与道德秩序。
lu-jia.oneLineEn: Early Han essayist who, in Xinyu, reads Qin fall and Han rise as a case for civil moral order.

zengzi.oneLineZh: 孔门后学，以孝道、慎独与日省修身承接儒家日常工夫。
zengzi.oneLineEn: Later Confucian disciple transmitting filiality, vigilance in solitude, and daily self-examination.

zisi.oneLineZh: 孔子之孙，处孔孟之间，传承中庸与心性脉络的关键环节。
zisi.oneLineEn: Confucius's grandson, a key link between Confucius and Mencius in Zhongyong and heart-nature lines.
